name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 13 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 13 hours starting 2025-07-04, at wavelengths from 1.70 to 4.87 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
